model_policy_governance_definition.description: MPGD (Model Policy Governance Definition) defines model-policy-specific governance delta for policy objects, policy and clause identity, versioning, applicability, scope, precedence, conflict, exception handling, contextual policy-decision risk, over-refusal and under-refusal, non-binary policy decision branches, decision traceability, appeal, repair, policy revision, migration, regression, and policy-decision records. MPGD does not replace parent reasoning or behavior governance, does not implement domain orchestration, does not assign final approval authority, does not govern agent execution itself, does not perform AI security threat analysis, and does not govern artifact composition quality.

domain_scope.scope_statement: governance of model-policy decision basis and lineage, including policy identity, applicability, scope, precedence, conflict, exception, over-refusal, under-refusal, appeal, repair, revision, migration, and decision records

sibling_boundary_map.daagd: authority, accountability, delegation, approval ownership, and final authority assignment remain outside MPGD
sibling_boundary_map.aagd: tool execution, side effects, checkpoints, retries, handoff, and agent execution control remain outside MPGD
sibling_boundary_map.aisgd: AI-mediated security risk, prompt injection, tool abuse, leakage, and attack-surface analysis remain outside MPGD
sibling_boundary_map.acrgd: response artifact composition, presentation quality, and publication readiness remain outside MPGD
sibling_boundary_map.cdogd: domain routing, activation priority, registry, and cross-domain precedence remain outside MPGD

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: keep MPGD as model-policy decision governance rather than case-specific policy content or product safety implementation

role_complete_separation.principle: MPGD governs model-policy decision basis and lineage only; inherited reasoning governance, general behavior governance, external orchestration, authority assignment, agent execution, AI security analysis, artifact-quality governance, records, and metadata remain separate

separation_targets.source_material: requests, policy references, context, evidence, appeals, or prior decisions used for policy-decision work; source content is not absorbed by default
separation_targets.domain_definition: model-policy-specific rules, checks, failures, repair origins, records, and responsibility boundaries
separation_targets.inherited_governance: parent reasoning and behavior governance referenced as authoritative context and not re-expanded inside MPGD
separation_targets.sibling_reference: other domain definitions referenced only as relevance or handoff conditions and not absorbed
separation_targets.governed_target: the model-policy object, clause, decision, branch, obligation, appeal, repair, revision, migration, or record being governed
separation_targets.domain_repair: model-policy-specific repair origins and revalidation scopes, not the parent repair cycle itself
separation_targets.activation: local applicability and reactivation signals only; routing and priority remain external
separation_targets.status_reporting: model-policy delta reporting only, not broad runtime status replacement
separation_targets.records: model-policy decision and evaluation lineage records, structurally separate from metadata
separation_targets.external_orchestration: routing, registry, priority, and activation orchestration remain external
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information remain metadata, not domain rules

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: prevent MPGD from absorbing sibling governance while still reporting material cross-domain relevance conditions

policy_object_model.purpose: define the minimum model-policy object structure needed for policy decision governance without defining private policy content

decision_context_model.purpose: define the domain-local context needed to decide model-policy applicability and response or action obligation alignment

policy_request_and_context_intake.purpose: preserve the request or proposed model action and identify the initial policy-decision context without converting it into a binary allow/refuse question

policy_candidate_identification.purpose: identify candidate policies and clauses before selecting any one policy as controlling

policy_identity_and_version_validation.purpose: validate policy and clause identity, version, source reference, and lifecycle state for material decisions

applicability_and_scope_assessment.purpose: assess applicability, exclusion, scope inclusion, and scope exclusion for each material candidate policy and clause

precedence_and_conflict_assessment.purpose: resolve policy-level precedence and clause-level conflict without taking over external domain routing or cross-domain priority

ordinary_rule_and_exception_assessment.purpose: evaluate ordinary policy rules and bounded exceptions while preserving parent rules, residual constraints, and revocation conditions

policy_risk_and_uncertainty_assessment.purpose: assess contextual policy-decision risk and uncertainty without absorbing AI security threat analysis from AISGD

model_policy_falsification.purpose: apply parent falsification procedure to model-policy-specific applicability, scope, precedence, exception, risk, over-refusal, under-refusal, and branch-selection targets

non_binary_decision_branch_selection.purpose: select among non-binary policy decision branches with explicit basis and rejected-branch reasons

response_or_action_obligation_alignment.purpose: check whether the proposed response or material external action is aligned with the selected policy decision, without governing artifact composition or agent execution

policy_decision_recording.purpose: create or update domain-minimal records for material model-policy decisions without overwriting prior decisions

policy_decision_evaluation.purpose: evaluate the completed policy decision across domain-specific axes and report critical invalidation when present

appeal_re_evaluation_repair_or_migration.purpose: track appeal, re-evaluation, repair, policy revision, migration, and regression only as model-policy decision lineage, not as final authority assignment

policy_decision_status_reporting.purpose: emit compact domain-delta status when requested or when anomaly, blocking failure, appeal, repair, or migration conditions are material

repair.purpose: identify model-policy-specific repair origins and affected revalidation scopes without replacing parent repair governance

appeal_and_re_evaluation.purpose: track model-policy appeal and re-evaluation scope while preserving the original decision and avoiding final authority assignment

policy_revision_and_migration.purpose: govern model-policy revision and migration as policy-decision lineage and regression-review concerns

disclosure_and_threat_model.purpose: preserve public generic governance scope while preventing disclosure of private policy, product security
